## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* sectional analysis (*kē* 科) of Zhànrán's *Jīngāngbēi* ([KR6d0175](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0175), T1932) by **Rényuè** 仁岳 — the principal Northern-Sòng *shānwài* spokesperson. Body attribution: *Sòng Yúnjiān shāmén Jìngyuè zhuàn* 宋　雲間沙門　淨岳　撰 (note: [淨岳](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E5%B2%B3) Jìngyuè vs the more standard form 仁岳 Rényuè; conventionally identified as an alternate name preserved in this attribution).

**Abstract**

Rényuè's *Kē* provides the structural-outline navigational apparatus to Zhànrán's *Jīngāngbēi* and belongs together with his parallel work on Zhànrán's *Shí bùèr mén* ([KR6d0162](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0162)). The composition is bracketed within Rényuè's productive period c. 1010–1060.
